dana.name: Dana
dana.description: A stock clerk restocking shelves for the morning shift.

dialog.greeting: Hey. Grab what you need, just log it on the sheet.

priya.name: Priya
priya.description: The overnight shift supervisor, keys clipped to her belt.

dialog.greeting: Everything's accounted for on my shift.

priya.default_dialog: Priya glances up from her clipboard.

otis.name: Otis
otis.description: A man in a folding chair at the dead end of the alley, with a battery lantern and a duffel bag that is never in the same state twice.

dialog.greeting: Don't tell me where it came from. I like not knowing. Put it down, I'll look at it.

otis.default_dialog: Otis turns his lantern down and waits.

properties._comment: The fence. He is the reason to carry something out of the depot rather than drop it: he buys anything, including the things the depot sells, and he sells the one tool that gets you back out of the holding room. No buy orders and no relationship ladder of his own -- he is a shop, not a friend.

stray_dog.name: stray dog
stray_dog.description: A lean, wary dog that's claimed the alley as its own.

dialog.greeting: The dog growls low in its throat.

stray_dog.default_dialog: The dog paces near the dumpster.
